title: Kabukichō in a rainstorm at night
lede: A narrow street in Tokyo’s Kabukichō entertainment district during heavy rain: stacked vertical signs in pink, green, and white, and their reflections on the wet asphalt.
summary: Pink-lit facades, vertical Japanese signs, and a rain-wet street at night. Photograph by Benlisquare, Shinjuku, Tokyo, 2024.

source.label: Wikimedia Commons: Kabukicho during rainstorm at night.jpg

evidence.note: Downloaded and inspected the Commons 1920 px rendition of the 4000 × 3000 px original. The file description reads “Kabukichō at night, during a heavy rainstorm.”

styles.note: Partial fit: a real street of the kind the genre took as its model, with rain, reflections, and vertical neon signs in Japanese. It has no HUD frames or terminal text.

context: Wikipedia’s [Cyberpunk article](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cyberpunk) quotes William Gibson: “Modern Japan simply was cyberpunk.” He describes Shibuya’s “towering, animated crawl of commercial information” and a journalist saying “It is Blade Runner”. See [Blade Runner](ref:blade-runner-1982) and [Akira](ref:akira-film-1988).

Kabukichō is an entertainment and red-light district in Shinjuku, Tokyo. The photograph is in the Commons category “Kabukichō Sakura Street at night”. [Commons](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Kabukicho_during_rainstorm_at_night.jpg).
observed: The left side is a wall of yellow, red, and blue illuminated panels edged with green and blue LED strips.
The buildings on the right are washed in pink light. Vertical signs read “ROBOT★RESTAURANT”, “NEO TOKIO”, and “Shisha Alchemist 3F” with Japanese text, and floor numbers such as “1F” and “B1”.
The asphalt is wet and reflects pink and yellow light in long streaks. Rain is visible against the black sky.
A black van stands in the center. Paper lanterns and a backlit menu board are at lower right.
The sky and the upper buildings are near-black. Almost all light comes from the signs.
interpretation: The photograph shows where the style’s palette comes from: no daylight, all light emitted by signs, and a wet ground that doubles it.
The colors here are warmer and more varied (pink, yellow, green) than the cyan-and-magenta palette of designed cyberpunk graphics. Designers reduce this to two or three hues.
borrow: Light a dark composition only from its signs and labels, and add a soft reflection below a bright element.
Stack short labels vertically, with floor or level codes such as “3F” and “B1”, as data.

images.alt: A narrow street at night in heavy rain. Bright yellow and red illuminated panels line the left; pink-lit buildings with vertical signs in Japanese and English line the right. A black van stands on the wet, reflecting road.
images.caption: Kabukichō, Shinjuku, Tokyo, during a rainstorm, 7 August 2024. Photograph by Benlisquare, [Wikimedia Commons](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Kabukicho_during_rainstorm_at_night.jpg), CC BY-SA 4.0. Shop signs and advertising appear incidentally as part of the street.

rights.statement: Photograph by Benlisquare, “Own work”, licensed CC BY-SA 4.0 on Wikimedia Commons. The main subject is a public street. Shop signs, logos, and a printed advertisement appear as incidental parts of the street scene, not as the subject.
